video_type.zh: 现代都市直播逆袭账号复仇爽文反转短剧
video_type.en: Modern Urban Livestream Revenge Comeback Thriller

visual_style_tags: 都市舆论战 / Urban Public Opinion War
冷光屏幕美学 / Cold Screen Glow Aesthetic
爽文打脸节奏 / Face-Slapping Revenge Rhythm
全网围观 / Viral Public Spectacle

location.zh: 深夜，廉价出租屋改成的临时直播间，黑色桌布、补光灯和一支旧口红摆在镜头前
location.en: Late night makeshift livestream room in a cheap apartment, black table cloth, ring light, old lipstick placed before the camera

lighting.zh: 单盏冷白补光灯打在口红和温栀手上，背景几乎全黑，屏幕弹幕冷光映出她半张脸
lighting.en: Cold white ring light on the lipstick and Wen Zhi's hand, nearly black background, livestream comments glow across half her face

visual_anchor.zh: 29岁亚洲女性，冷艳疲惫但眼神清醒，黑色西装外套，低马尾，干净冷调妆容，直播镜头前克制锋利
visual_anchor.en: A 29-year-old Asian woman, cold elegant and exhausted yet clear-eyed, black blazer, low ponytail, restrained cool-toned makeup, sharp composure on livestream camera

action.zh: 她没有露脸，只把三年前被判定为假货的口红推到镜头中央，手指稳稳按下开播键
action.en: She stays off-camera, pushes the lipstick once judged fake into frame, and calmly taps the go-live button

camera_movement.zh: 从直播开播按钮特写切到在线人数7，再缓慢推近口红批号
camera_movement.en: Cut from the go-live button close-up to viewer count 7, then slowly push in on the lipstick batch code

audio_cue.zh: 空调低鸣、键盘轻响、零星弹幕提示音，温栀低声说：今晚不带货，只还债
audio_cue.en: Low air-conditioner hum, soft keyboard tap, sparse comment pings, Wen Zhi says: no selling tonight, only debt repayment

location.zh: 同一直播间，弹幕投屏墙突然刷满辱骂账号，后台数据面板在副屏闪烁
location.en: Same livestream room, comment wall flooded by abusive accounts, backend data dashboard flickering on side monitor

lighting.zh: 冷蓝屏幕光压住房间，辱骂弹幕用红色高亮框逐个标记
lighting.en: Cold blue screen light fills the room, abusive comments are highlighted one by one in red boxes

visual_anchor.zh: 29岁亚洲女性，冷艳疲惫但眼神清醒，黑色西装外套，低马尾，干净冷调妆容，直播镜头前克制锋利
visual_anchor.en: A 29-year-old Asian woman, cold elegant and exhausted yet clear-eyed, black blazer, low ponytail, restrained cool-toned makeup, sharp composure on livestream camera

action.zh: 她不关弹幕，反而把骂得最狠的账号逐一投屏标红，表情冷静到近乎审判
action.en: She does not close comments, instead marks the most abusive accounts on screen, calm like a judge

visual_anchor.zh: 31岁亚洲男性，冷静克制，黑框眼镜，深灰衬衫，技术取证师气质，屏幕蓝光映脸
visual_anchor.en: A 31-year-old Asian man, calm and restrained, black-rim glasses, dark gray shirt, digital forensic analyst presence, blue screen glow on his face

action.zh: 他在远程数据室追踪水军来源，黑框眼镜反射出同一个MCN水军池地址
action.en: He traces the troll source in a remote data room, black-rim glasses reflecting the same MCN bot pool address

camera_movement.zh: 分屏镜头：左侧温栀直播间，右侧陆沉舟数据追踪界面，最后合到水军订单备注特写
camera_movement.en: Split-screen: Wen Zhi's livestream on the left, Lu Chenzhou's tracking dashboard on the right, ending on the troll order note close-up

audio_cue.zh: 密集弹幕声、数据锁定提示音、温栀念出备注：今晚必须逼她下播
audio_cue.en: Dense comment pings, data lock sound, Wen Zhi reads the note: force her offline tonight

location.zh: 直播间切换成消费者维权普法现场，桌面摆着三年前质检报告、律师连麦窗口和商品样本
location.en: Livestream switches into consumer rights legal education setup, old quality report, lawyer call window, product sample on table

lighting.zh: 白色补光灯变得更明亮，报告纸面反光，律师窗口带有冷蓝边框
lighting.en: Brighter white ring light, report paper reflecting light, lawyer window framed in cool blue

visual_anchor.zh: 29岁亚洲女性，冷艳疲惫但眼神清醒，黑色西装外套，低马尾，干净冷调妆容，直播镜头前克制锋利
visual_anchor.en: A 29-year-old Asian woman, cold elegant and exhausted yet clear-eyed, black blazer, low ponytail, restrained cool-toned makeup, sharp composure on livestream camera

action.zh: 她卡在封禁规则边缘，用消费者维权话术讲完三年前质检漏洞
action.en: She walks the edge of platform rules, explaining the old quality-test loophole as consumer rights education

visual_anchor.zh: 31岁亚洲男性，冷静克制，黑框眼镜，深灰衬衫，技术取证师气质，屏幕蓝光映脸
visual_anchor.en: A 31-year-old Asian man, calm and restrained, black-rim glasses, dark gray shirt, digital forensic analyst presence, blue screen glow on his face

action.zh: 他盯着封禁倒计时，手指停在防封脚本开关上
action.en: He watches the ban countdown, finger hovering over an anti-ban script switch

camera_movement.zh: 俯拍报告与口红样本，随后推到律师指出送检人姓名的位置
camera_movement.en: Top-down shot of report and lipstick sample, then push to where the lawyer points at the submitter name

audio_cue.zh: 封禁警告提示音、律师清晰解读声、倒计时归零前的低频鼓点
audio_cue.en: Ban warning beep, lawyer's clear explanation, low drum hit before countdown reaches zero

location.zh: 乔蔓千万粉直播间，粉色柔光、玩偶背景和大面积暖色滤镜营造无辜人设
location.en: Qiao Man's multi-million follower livestream room, pink soft light, plush background, warm filter for innocent persona

lighting.zh: 暖粉色美颜灯包裹乔蔓，屏幕角落却有工作人员焦急的冷蓝后台光
lighting.en: Warm pink beauty light wraps Qiao Man, while cold blue backstage monitor glow reveals anxious staff in the corner

visual_anchor.zh: 27岁亚洲女性，甜美亲和，小白花主播妆容，浅色针织衫，镜头前会卖惨，眼神深处有慌乱
visual_anchor.en: A 27-year-old Asian woman, sweet approachable influencer look, pale knitwear, tearful innocent livestream persona, panic hidden in her eyes

action.zh: 她对镜头含泪控诉师父不肯放过自己，擦泪角度精准得像排练过
action.en: She tearfully accuses her mentor on camera, wiping tears at a perfectly rehearsed angle

visual_anchor.zh: 29岁亚洲女性，冷艳疲惫但眼神清醒，黑色西装外套，低马尾，干净冷调妆容，直播镜头前克制锋利
visual_anchor.en: A 29-year-old Asian woman, cold elegant and exhausted yet clear-eyed, black blazer, low ponytail, restrained cool-toned makeup, sharp composure on livestream camera

action.zh: 她在黑暗直播间里只发出一条预告，眼神没有任何波动
action.en: In her dark room, Wen Zhi posts one preview message with no emotion in her eyes

camera_movement.zh: 先用乔蔓柔焦近景，再硬切温栀冷色屏幕和预告文案特写
camera_movement.en: Start with Qiao Man soft-focus close-up, hard cut to Wen Zhi's cold screen and preview post close-up

audio_cue.zh: 乔蔓哽咽声、粉丝刷屏音、温栀房间里只有鼠标点击声
audio_cue.en: Qiao Man sobbing, fan comment spam, only mouse clicks in Wen Zhi's room

location.zh: 温栀直播间变成拆解课堂，屏幕上并排播放乔蔓现在哭戏和三年前彩排视频
location.en: Wen Zhi's livestream becomes a breakdown class, screen comparing Qiao Man's current crying act with rehearsal footage from three years ago

lighting.zh: 冷白教学灯照亮温栀，两个视频窗口一暖一冷形成强烈对比
lighting.en: Cold teaching light on Wen Zhi, two video windows warm and cold in strong contrast

visual_anchor.zh: 29岁亚洲女性，冷艳疲惫但眼神清醒，黑色西装外套，低马尾，干净冷调妆容，直播镜头前克制锋利
visual_anchor.en: A 29-year-old Asian woman, cold elegant and exhausted yet clear-eyed, black blazer, low ponytail, restrained cool-toned makeup, sharp composure on livestream camera

action.zh: 她逐帧拆解乔蔓停顿、侧脸、擦泪角度和关键词植入，语气像在讲直播课
action.en: She breaks down Qiao Man's pauses, side profile, tear wiping angle, and keywords frame by frame like teaching a livestream class

visual_anchor.zh: 27岁亚洲女性，甜美亲和，小白花主播妆容，浅色针织衫，镜头前会卖惨，眼神深处有慌乱
visual_anchor.en: A 27-year-old Asian woman, sweet approachable influencer look, pale knitwear, tearful innocent livestream persona, panic hidden in her eyes

action.zh: 彩排视频里的她反复练习控诉台词，笑场后又立刻进入哭腔
action.en: In rehearsal footage she practices accusation lines repeatedly, laughs, then instantly resumes crying

camera_movement.zh: 屏幕录制感快速切换，最后定格周启明声音出现时温栀抬眼的瞬间
camera_movement.en: Screen-recording style fast cuts, ending frozen on Wen Zhi looking up as Zhou Qiming's voice appears

audio_cue.zh: 视频倒放声、鼠标点击声、周启明录音：哭狠一点，明天你就是新一姐
audio_cue.en: Video rewind sound, mouse clicks, Zhou Qiming's recording: cry harder, tomorrow you'll be the new queen

location.zh: 陆沉舟的独立数据取证工作室，多屏幕显示账号风控路径和平台封禁模型
location.en: Lu Chenzhou's independent forensic studio, multiple screens showing account risk paths and platform ban model

lighting.zh: 屏幕蓝光切割黑暗，陆沉舟脸部一半明一半暗，技术感压迫
lighting.en: Blue screen light cuts through darkness, Lu's face half-lit, half-shadowed, technical pressure

visual_anchor.zh: 29岁亚洲女性，冷艳疲惫但眼神清醒，黑色西装外套，低马尾，干净冷调妆容，直播镜头前克制锋利
visual_anchor.en: A 29-year-old Asian woman, cold elegant and exhausted yet clear-eyed, black blazer, low ponytail, restrained cool-toned makeup, sharp composure on livestream camera

action.zh: 她站在直播间门口与陆沉舟对峙，问他是来封她还是来帮她
action.en: She confronts Lu at the livestream room door, asking if he came to ban her or help her

visual_anchor.zh: 31岁亚洲男性，冷静克制，黑框眼镜，深灰衬衫，技术取证师气质，屏幕蓝光映脸
visual_anchor.en: A 31-year-old Asian man, calm and restrained, black-rim glasses, dark gray shirt, digital forensic analyst presence, blue screen glow on his face

action.zh: 他拿出三年前后台数据，声音克制地说封号指令不是平台发的
action.en: He presents old backend data and calmly says the ban order did not come from the platform

camera_movement.zh: 从数据屏幕推到陆沉舟眼镜反光，再反打温栀充满敌意的侧脸
camera_movement.en: Push from data screens to reflection in Lu's glasses, reverse to Wen Zhi's hostile side profile

audio_cue.zh: 服务器风扇声、键盘短促敲击、两人之间长时间沉默
audio_cue.en: Server fan hum, short keyboard taps, long silence between them

location.zh: 直播间大屏显示三年前封号路径可视化图，观众弹幕像雪崩一样涌入
location.en: Livestream big screen shows visualization of the old account ban path, comments flood like an avalanche

lighting.zh: 蓝白数据线在黑背景上延展，温栀和陆沉舟被屏幕光照成冷色剪影
lighting.en: Blue-white data lines stretch over black background, Wen Zhi and Lu appear as cool silhouettes

visual_anchor.zh: 31岁亚洲男性，冷静克制，黑框眼镜，深灰衬衫，技术取证师气质，屏幕蓝光映脸
visual_anchor.en: A 31-year-old Asian man, calm and restrained, black-rim glasses, dark gray shirt, digital forensic analyst presence, blue screen glow on his face

action.zh: 他连麦解释外部加密账号权限高于平台内部员工，指针停在星途MCN总部位置
action.en: On call, he explains the external encrypted account had higher privileges than staff, pointer stopping at Xingtu MCN headquarters

visual_anchor.zh: 29岁亚洲女性，冷艳疲惫但眼神清醒，黑色西装外套，低马尾，干净冷调妆容，直播镜头前克制锋利
visual_anchor.en: A 29-year-old Asian woman, cold elegant and exhausted yet clear-eyed, black blazer, low ponytail, restrained cool-toned makeup, sharp composure on livestream camera

action.zh: 她没有解释，只把证据路径放大到全屏，让观众自己看懂
action.en: She does not explain, only enlarges the evidence path full-screen for viewers to understand

camera_movement.zh: 数据路径从平台节点一路追踪到MCN总部，最后切温栀沉默的眼睛
camera_movement.en: Track the data path from platform node to MCN headquarters, then cut to Wen Zhi's silent eyes

audio_cue.zh: 数据连线音、弹幕爆炸提示、观众倒吸气般的群体低鸣
audio_cue.en: Data connection tones, exploding comment alerts, collective gasp-like ambience

location.zh: 周启明豪华直播间，深色木质背景、行业奖杯和认责协议摆在桌面中央
location.en: Zhou Qiming's luxury livestream room, dark wood background, industry trophies, liability agreement on the desk

lighting.zh: 暖金商业灯打在奖杯上，协议纸面被一束冷光切开
lighting.en: Warm gold business light on trophies, a cold beam cuts across the agreement paper

visual_anchor.zh: 38岁亚洲男性，星途MCN老板，深色商务西装，笑容温和但压迫感强，手戴昂贵腕表
visual_anchor.en: A 38-year-old Asian man, MCN boss in dark business suit, gentle smile with oppressive aura, expensive wristwatch

action.zh: 他温和地说温栀三年前就有被害妄想，并展示认责协议
action.en: He calmly claims Wen Zhi had persecution delusions and shows the liability agreement

visual_anchor.zh: 29岁亚洲女性，冷艳疲惫但眼神清醒，黑色西装外套，低马尾，干净冷调妆容，直播镜头前克制锋利
visual_anchor.en: A 29-year-old Asian woman, cold elegant and exhausted yet clear-eyed, black blazer, low ponytail, restrained cool-toned makeup, sharp composure on livestream camera

action.zh: 她没有否认签字，只冷声说签字时母亲在他们手里
action.en: She does not deny signing, only says coldly that her mother was in their hands

camera_movement.zh: 先拍周启明稳重中景，再切温栀直播间冷色特写，最后插入医院监控画面
camera_movement.en: Start on Zhou's composed medium shot, cut to Wen Zhi's cold close-up, insert hospital surveillance footage

audio_cue.zh: 奖杯轻碰声、协议翻页声、温栀一句话后直播间弹幕瞬间静音
audio_cue.en: Trophy clink, paper turning, livestream comments fall silent after Wen Zhi's line

location.zh: 医院单人病房，夜色窗户、呼吸机、病床边放着三年前网暴剪报和旧手机
location.en: Single hospital ward at night, window darkness, ventilator, old cyberbullying clippings and phone by the bed

lighting.zh: 病房顶灯昏白，手机屏幕突然亮起绿色提示光，温栀脸上第一次出现裂缝
lighting.en: Dim white ward light, old phone suddenly glows green, Wen Zhi's expression cracks for the first time

visual_anchor.zh: 29岁亚洲女性，冷艳疲惫但眼神清醒，黑色西装外套，低马尾，干净冷调妆容，直播镜头前克制锋利
visual_anchor.en: A 29-year-old Asian woman, cold elegant and exhausted yet clear-eyed, black blazer, low ponytail, restrained cool-toned makeup, sharp composure on livestream camera

action.zh: 她带镜头走到母亲床边，努力保持平静却在三秒内失控又收回
action.en: She brings the camera to her mother's bed, nearly breaks down for three seconds, then regains control

visual_anchor.zh: 病床上的中年亚洲女性，苍白虚弱，手指微颤，病房灯光下显得安静而脆弱
visual_anchor.en: A middle-aged Asian woman in hospital bed, pale and weak, trembling fingers, fragile under ward lighting

action.zh: 她昏迷躺在病床上，手指几乎不可见地颤了一下
action.en: She lies unconscious, fingers trembling almost imperceptibly

camera_movement.zh: 手持镜头进入病房，慢慢推近旧手机收到短信的屏幕光
camera_movement.en: Handheld camera enters ward, slowly pushes to old phone screen glow

audio_cue.zh: 呼吸机规律声、直播间弹幕渐渐变少、短信提示音突兀刺耳
audio_cue.en: Regular ventilator beeps, comments fade, sudden sharp text alert

location.zh: 温栀深夜登录旧邮箱，屏幕上打开林晚未发送邮件，房间只有电脑冷光
location.en: Wen Zhi logs into old email late at night, opening Lin Wan's unsent email, room lit only by cold monitor light

lighting.zh: 电脑蓝光照亮温栀僵硬的脸，背景全黑，邮件附件损坏图标闪烁
lighting.en: Blue monitor glow lights Wen Zhi's frozen face, black background, corrupted attachment icon blinking

visual_anchor.zh: 29岁亚洲女性，冷艳疲惫但眼神清醒，黑色西装外套，低马尾，干净冷调妆容，直播镜头前克制锋利
visual_anchor.en: A 29-year-old Asian woman, cold elegant and exhausted yet clear-eyed, black blazer, low ponytail, restrained cool-toned makeup, sharp composure on livestream camera

action.zh: 她看到标题写着如果我死了查乔蔓，指尖停在鼠标上许久没有动
action.en: She sees the title saying if I die, investigate Qiao Man, her finger frozen on the mouse

visual_anchor.zh: 已故年轻女助理，素净白衬衫，疲惫眼神，常以旧视频、邮件残影和监控画面出现
visual_anchor.en: A deceased young female assistant, plain white shirt, tired eyes, appearing through old videos, email traces, and surveillance footage

action.zh: 她以旧邮件残影出现，像从三年前的黑暗里发出最后一次求救
action.en: She appears as an old email trace, like a final cry for help from three years ago

camera_movement.zh: 从邮箱收件箱俯拍推到温栀瞳孔反光，再切损坏视频缩略图
camera_movement.en: Top-down shot of inbox pushing into Wen Zhi's reflected pupils, then cut to corrupted video thumbnail

audio_cue.zh: 老电脑硬盘声、邮件打开音、远处城市夜雨声压低
audio_cue.en: Old hard-drive hum, email opening sound, distant city rain subdued

location.zh: MCN仓库旧视频画面，货架阴影、假货箱和直播前备货区被监控噪点覆盖
location.en: Old MCN warehouse video, shelf shadows, counterfeit boxes, pre-livestream packing area under surveillance noise

lighting.zh: 监控黑白绿噪点和手电光交替，林晚偷拍画面不断抖动
lighting.en: Black-white-green surveillance noise and flashlight beams alternate, Lin Wan's hidden footage shakes

visual_anchor.zh: 已故年轻女助理，素净白衬衫，疲惫眼神，常以旧视频、邮件残影和监控画面出现
visual_anchor.en: A deceased young female assistant, plain white shirt, tired eyes, appearing through old videos, email traces, and surveillance footage

action.zh: 她躲在货架后偷拍假货调包过程，呼吸越来越急
action.en: She hides behind shelves filming product swap, breathing faster

visual_anchor.zh: 29岁亚洲女性，冷艳疲惫但眼神清醒，黑色西装外套，低马尾，干净冷调妆容，直播镜头前克制锋利
visual_anchor.en: A 29-year-old Asian woman, cold elegant and exhausted yet clear-eyed, black blazer, low ponytail, restrained cool-toned makeup, sharp composure on livestream camera

action.zh: 她在现实直播间看着修复视频，眼神从悲伤变成冷硬
action.en: In the present livestream room she watches restored footage, grief hardening into resolve

camera_movement.zh: 监控素材全屏播放，忽然暂停在许嘉年鞋子入镜的一帧
camera_movement.en: Surveillance footage plays full-screen, abruptly pauses on a frame showing Xu Jianian's shoes

audio_cue.zh: 视频噪点、电流修复声、林晚压低的喘息声
audio_cue.en: Video noise, digital repair crackle, Lin Wan's suppressed breathing

location.zh: 许嘉年娱乐直播间，彩灯、夸张道具和满屏礼物特效营造轻松气氛
location.en: Xu Jianian's entertainment livestream room, colorful lights, exaggerated props, gift effects filling the screen

lighting.zh: 彩色舞台灯很热闹，温栀连麦窗口的冷白光像刀一样切入画面
lighting.en: Colorful stage lights feel lively, Wen Zhi's cold call-in window cuts into the frame like a blade

location.en: Final livestream room, surrounding screens play the full evidence chain, viewers exceed fifty million, ring lights like a courtroom

lighting.zh: 冷白补光灯与红色录制灯交错，温栀站在镜头中央像完成公开处刑
lighting.en: Cold white ring lights and red recording light intersect, Wen Zhi stands center frame like completing a public execution

visual_anchor.zh: 29岁亚洲女性，冷艳疲惫但眼神清醒，黑色西装外套，低马尾，干净冷调妆容，直播镜头前克制锋利
visual_anchor.en: A 29-year-old Asian woman, cold elegant and exhausted yet clear-eyed, black blazer, low ponytail, restrained cool-toned makeup, sharp composure on livestream camera

action.zh: 她放出假货调包、助理死亡、母亲威胁、平台内鬼、洗钱和程砚录音完整证据链
action.en: She releases the complete evidence chain: product swap, assistant death, mother threat, platform insider, laundering, Cheng's recording

visual_anchor.zh: 已故年轻女助理，素净白衬衫，疲惫眼神，常以旧视频、邮件残影和监控画面出现
visual_anchor.en: A deceased young female assistant, plain white shirt, tired eyes, appearing through old videos, email traces, and surveillance footage

action.zh: 直播结束后，她的已故账号突然发来私信，像从黑暗里重新睁眼
action.en: After the livestream, her deceased account sends a message, like opening eyes from darkness

camera_movement.zh: 环绕温栀和四周证据屏幕，最后推到后台私信弹窗的冷光
camera_movement.en: Orbit Wen Zhi and evidence screens, finally push into the cold glow of the private message popup

audio_cue.zh: 全网弹幕欢呼声逐渐抽空，私信提示音落下后瞬间静默
audio_cue.en: Nationwide comment cheers drain away, private message ping drops into silence
